args.title: payments-api elevated error rate after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api has been throwing errors since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Error rate observed at ~18% across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), service unhealthy. Rolled back to last known healthy production release v5.0.0. On-call to verify recovery and investigate root cause in v5.1.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Situation:** `payments-api` was running v5.1.0 (this morning's deploy) and was unhealthy with an ~18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `payments-api` to **v5.0.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production (v5.1.0 was marked "degraded" in the release history). The rollback was applied to all three production regions.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the elevated error rate after the v5.1.0 deploy and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Verification:** After the rollback, `payments-api` is now **healthy** on v5.0.0 with the error rate down to **0.2%** across all regions. Recovery is confirmed.
